text:
The 1960 deed gave the friend a fee simple subject to a shifting executory interest in the sister’s children who reach 25, and that interest is void under the common-law Rule Against Perpetuities because church use and survival to 25 might occur more than 21 years after every life in being at the conveyance. Striking it leaves the friend with a fee simple absolute; later births and deaths do not revive the gift.

CONFIDENCE: 74
